completion:
3. Press the edit button.
4. Open the section that has the correct type of accident report form.
5. Fill the correct fields with the information as mentioned in the section displayed in the table.
6. Click the save&next button.
7. Then, proceed the same way for the other tables and save&finish the document.



## How to check whether the accident report should be documented

## When a report is needed for this type of accidents

- **Injuries that result in death:** if it occurred in your business in less than 30 days after an accident; if the injured person died because of the accident in that time;

- **Inpatient hospitalization:** if it occurred in your business in less than 24 hours after an accident; if the injured person was hospitalized because of the accident in that time;

- **Injuries that result in loss of one or more members:** regardless of
